extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/registered practitioners or petitioners seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (particularly for trademark and non-patent matters)
extracted.subtask_description: Filing and adjudication of a Petition for Reinstatement under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 to regain eligibility to practice before the USPTO (here, reinstatement limited to trademark and other non-patent matters). The Director/Office of Enrollment and Discipline reviews the petition, supporting affidavit, and the record to determine appropriateness of reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition filing under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: A Petition for Reinstatement must be filed and supported by an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The petition should include the required supporting affidavit and be submitted to the Office of Enrollment and Discipline; the decision notes the petition was received on a specific date (e.g., July 23, 2025).

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, affidavit, and record material
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director (or Acting Director) evaluates the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to the petitioner's eligibility for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjudication is based on a careful review of the petition, affidavit, and any relevant record information to determine whether reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Determination of scope of reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office may grant reinstatement with a defined scope (for example, reinstatement to practice before the USPTO in trademark and other non-patent matters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision may specify the areas of practice for which reinstatement is permitted; in this case, reinstatement was limited to trademark and other non-patent matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance and service of decision
rubrics_metrics.description: A signed decision is issued by the Director/Acting Director with an effective date, and copies are sent to counsel of record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision includes an official signature line, date (e.g., October 29, 2025), and a service list identifying copies delivered to counsel and their addresses.
